label: Object icons other than weapons. See README.md in this folder.
style: Hand-painted, realistic dark-fantasy game art in the manner of a gritty tactical RPG: believable metal, wood, leather, cloth, glass and stone, painterly but precise, strong value contrast. Shapes must stay readable when the image is shrunk to 48 pixels, and each object must be told apart from similar objects at a glance by its silhouette and colours.

rules.item: A single object for a game inventory icon. Soft light from the upper left. Fully transparent background: no table, no ground, no cast shadow, no text, no frame.

items.name: plate_mail
items.refNote: Image 1 is the pixel-art icon this art replaces. Keep exactly its placement, orientation, angle, view and proportions; paint it as realistic, hand-painted art and ignore the blocky pixels.

items.name: potion
items.refNote: Image 1 is the pixel-art icon this art replaces. Keep exactly its placement, orientation, angle, view and proportions; paint it as realistic, hand-painted art and ignore the blocky pixels.
items.prompt: A potion: a round-bellied clear glass flask with a narrow neck and a brown cork, half full of liquid, glass highlights and reflections on its sides. The liquid is the colour key. The colour key: paint that part in flat, pure vivid magenta (#FF00FF) with ordinary light and shade on it. It will be recoloured later, so nothing else in the picture may be magenta, pink, purple or red.
